versions.content: If on-the-fly gatewaying is used and PduR_<SrcLo Tp>CopyRxData is called and the provided data cannot be stored in the buffer, then BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK shall be returned and the execution of the I-PDU gateway shall be stopped.
